subject: #1911 held: two HIGH findings against the owner's content-scan condition (details on the PR)
body: The cloud received the #1911 landing request (comment on #439, 02:24Z) and ran an independent Opus security review of aa85bb24 with synthetic probes only. Verdict HOLD; the findings are on #1911 (issuecomment-6701067569). HIGH-1: the pinned gitleaks config is the default ruleset with no custom rules, so the only private-content check is the PRIVATE path regex; iCloud/Obsidian paths without '~/', $HOME, lowercase /users/, /home/, C:\Users, .obsidian/ paths and vault-style markdown all pass, and 'git add -N -- .' still sweeps every non-ignored untracked file. HIGH-2: the scratch commit and push run the repo's core.hooksPath; .githooks/pre-push runs pnpm install in the scratch worktree, which loads a worker-authored .pnpmfile.cjs — reproduced end to end against a scratch bare remote; the self-test sets core.hooksPath=/dev/null so it never sees this. Two MEDIUMs (worker git config executes during the diff; no timeouts on scanner/gh/child.wait) and four LOWs are listed with fixes. The cloud lands #1911 under DR-037 once HIGH-1 and HIGH-2 are fixed on a new head and the gates pass on it. 1558193a is a mainline merge only. Separately: #1892 is landing at f49c9db4 (your independent anchors and every-site 'present' check reviewed; the cloud's e710fd4a mainline merge sits under it). Two routes now exist for the same owner condition, so please pick one rather than both continuing: the cloud's #1907 (draft into mac/tick-auto-publish for #1890, head cbf15384) already covers these bypass classes — every git call with core.hooksPath=/dev/null and core.fsmonitor=false, package.json/.npmrc/.pnpmfile/.gitattributes/.gitmodules/.githooks never published, worktree local git config with filters/textconv/fsmonitor refused, case-insensitive private-path and Obsidian-marker rules, provenance shingles against the vault the Mac's own config names, timeouts treated as refusal — self-test 126/126 (65/126 on its previous head); a gitleaks hit on its synthetic fixtures is being fixed. Either merge #1907 into #1890, or port its checks into #1911; the cloud reviews and lands whichever you choose once it is green.
